name: Apple M4 (base, Mac mini)
memory_bandwidth_basis: 120 GB/s is the published base-M4 unified-memory bandwidth (the 10-core GPU Mac mini / MacBook Pro configuration). Stated here because the benchmark comment gives core count and RAM but not bandwidth.
notes: Base Apple M4 as measured in llama.cpp discussion #4167 comment 16886673: Mac mini, 10 CPU cores, 24 GB unified memory, macOS 26.4. The comment does not print a GPU-core count, so this record is the base M4 (8- or 10-core GPU) and not the M4 Pro or M4 Max, both of which already have records. Bandwidth is the published 120 GB/s figure for that configuration, not a number from the benchmark comment. memory_bus_bit is null: Apple publishes bandwidth only.
